Cannot isolate target/local connectivity.
missing: Fresh target ping/TCP and a distinct same-subnet control host ping.

rows.reason: Target ping={target_ping}, TCP={target_tcp80}; control host ping={control_ping}.
missing: Target console, route and firewall state; compare from CLI01.

rows.reason: Not applicable: HTTP service is declared absent on this host. This does not establish overall host health.
HTTP service applicability is unknown.
missing: Declare whether this host is expected to provide HTTP.

rows.reason: Direct local service state={local_service_state}; an HTTP service fault can coexist with a remote path failure.
missing: Inspect the service journal and whether an administrator stopped it.
actions: Inspect nginx service state and journal on the service host.

rows.reason: Missing usable ping/TCP evidence.
missing: Fresh ping and TCP port 80.

rows.reason: Target ping={target_ping}, TCP80={target_tcp80}.
HTTP200 on the target's own service IP; a simple stopped-service hypothesis is not supported. Check R5.
Remote TCP timeout alone cannot distinguish service and access-path failure.
missing: Fresh local HTTP probe from the service host.

rows.reason: Host ping works; TCP80={target_tcp80}; local HTTP={local_http}. Service/listener or active rejection suspected.
missing: Service state, listening sockets and firewall policy; refusal alone does not prove nginx stopped.
actions: On target inspect systemctl status nginx, ss -lntp and firewall rules.

rows.reason: Direct local agent state={local_agent_state}; this fault is independent of a remote parent path outage.
missing: Inspect agent service logs and configuration.

rows.reason: A recent agent.ping sample exists.
Cannot establish agent unavailability.
missing: Enabled usable agent.ping with no recent data, target ping and passive TCP10050 probe.

rows.reason: Host ping={target_ping}, agent.ping has no recent data, TCP10050={agent_tcp}.
missing: Agent mode, Server allow-list, service and firewall state.
actions: Inspect zabbix-agent2 service and its logs; do not assume service stopped.

rows.reason: Host ping={target_ping}, agent.ping has no recent data, TCP10050={agent_tcp}.

rows.reason: DNS target not configured.
missing: Actual application name and CLI01 DNS evidence.

rows.reason: DNS and IP control must be fresh and from the same intended observer.
missing: Run dns_probe.py on CLI01 for the configured name and control IP.

rows.reason: DNS collector did not produce an interpretable result.
missing: DNS response or timeout, not a missing executable/local command error.

rows.reason: DNS returned an A answer; this does not validate the expected IP.
IP control also failed; DNS-specific failure is not isolated.
missing: Working IP connectivity from the same observer.

rows.reason: IP control works on {dns_observer}; DNS status={dns_status}, rcode={dns_code}.
missing: Expected name/IP, intended resolver and resolver configuration; NXDOMAIN may be a spelling/name issue.
actions: Compare CLI01 resolver settings and query the intended resolver.

rows.reason: Not applicable: HTTP service is declared absent on this host. This does not establish overall host health.
HTTP service applicability is unknown.
missing: Declare whether this host is expected to provide HTTP.

rows.reason: No isolated remote HTTP connection failure with working ICMP.
Need remote ping/TCP and fresh HTTP evidence from the service host.
missing: Run http_probe.py on SRV01 and import its fresh JSON with --http-evidence.

rows.reason: Remote ping={target_ping}, TCP80={target_tcp80}; HTTP on target's own service IP={local_http}. Filtering/access-path failure is suspected, not proven firewall causation.
missing: Read firewall rules and relevant packet counters; compare another remote observer. Local HTTP does not traverse the same ingress path.
actions: Inspect SRV01 firewall and routes; compare HTTP from CLI01 before attributing cause.

rows.reason: Remote ping={target_ping}, TCP80={target_tcp80}; HTTP on target's own service IP={local_http}. The evidence does not meet R5 conditions for suspected filtering/access-path failure.

hypotheses.explanation: Expert-assigned investigation priority from this signature; not a calibrated probability or proof of root cause.

rows.reason: No usable CPU history.
missing: CPU percentage history over the last five minutes.

rows.reason: CPU history is sparse, stale or invalid.
missing: At least {cpu_min_coverage}s coverage, max {cpu_max_gap}s gap, latest sample <={max_age}s old.

rows.reason: Mean CPU={cpu_mean:.2f}%; below {cpu_high_percent}%.
CPU stays high, but load/cpu-count corroboration is missing.
missing: Usable CPU count <={cpu_count_max_age}s old (1d heartbeat + {max_age}s grace) and CPU load <={max_age}s old.

rows.reason: Mean CPU={cpu_mean:.2f}% over {cpu_span}s; threshold={cpu_high_percent}%; load={cpu_load:.2f}, CPUs={cpu_count:g}.
missing: Response-time baseline and top processes; CPU and load suggest but do not prove overload.
actions: Compare load and response time; inspect top processes.

rows.reason: Mean CPU={cpu_mean:.2f}% over {cpu_span}s; threshold={cpu_high_percent}%; load={cpu_load:.2f}, CPUs={cpu_count:g}.
